title: Rainfall regimes shape diversity in barley populations
content: Environmental factors have profound impact on seed development and maturation. It is known that temperature, water availability, and oxygen diffusion shape the physical properties of the seed coat and hormonal pathways that control dormancy and germination (Ali et al. 2021). Because crops are often exposed to both drought and flooding, understanding how local environmental conditions shape genetic diversity that affects seed traits and post-flood germination is not just academically interesting but is essential for improving agricultural resilience (Benech-Arnold et al. 2006).
